Crossing point of the velocity curves of two states

Source: R/group_compare.R
find_intersection.Rd

Interpolates both curves on a common grid of 1000 points over the shared rep_percent range and returns the first sign change of their difference.

Usage

find_intersection(data, state1, state2)

Arguments

data

data.frame with columns state, rep_percent and length_velocity (bp), e.g. the prediction table of fit_track_length_models().

state1, state2

The two states to compare.

Value

A one-row data.frame with x (rep_percent at the crossing) and y (velocity there, in kb), or NULL when the curves do not cross.

Examples

d <- data.frame(state = rep(c("ctr", "ama"), each = 11),
                rep_percent = rep(seq(0, 100, 10), 2),
                length_velocity = c(seq(1e4, 3e4, length.out = 11),
                                    seq(2.5e4, 1.5e4, length.out = 11)))
find_intersection(d, "ctr", "ama")
#>    x  y
#> 1 50 20
